title: Release cadence and stakeholder run-through for SDK/API feature trio (function-calling, structured output, streaming)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: synchronize product, engineering, design, docs, and GTM for the SDK + API surface ship that introduces first-class function-calling, structured output typing, and streaming for text/chat APIs. Scope: final release notes, SDK examples (Python/JS/Go), structured-output examples + canonical JSON schemas, streaming SDK snippets, compatibility matrix for older client versions, staging rollout plan for host and dedicated modes. Success metrics: documentation hit-rate on day-1 > 60% of active integrators, <1 severity release blocker at GA, and >=90% test coverage on SDK examples. Acceptance criteria: (1) release notes drafted and reviewed by PM/Eng/Docs; (2) SDK sample repo updated and green CI; (3) structured output schemas published and validated against runtime; (4) streaming endpoints tested against load targets; (5) GTM email + changelog scheduled.
tasks: Draft canonical release notes + short TL;DR for dev newsletter
Coordinate final SDK sample PRs across python/js/go repos
Validate structured-output schemas with runtime QA (edge cases + nullability)
Run streaming e2e across hosted and dedicated staging clusters
Finalize migration notes for customers using legacy sync-only endpoints
Prepare call script and demo app for partner preview session
Confirm telemetry events for feature usage are emitted and documented
Lock down API surface and flag breaking changes with compatibility matrix
notes: We will not include a new binary-only SDK release in the initial GA; instead we bump bindings and ship sample code while tracking desktop/binary packaging in a follow-up. Must ensure function-calling does not change existing token accounting unexpectedly.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting with Eng/Design/Docs. Agreed scope and draft timelines. Action: Eng to provide stability SLO targets (ENG-2431).

2026-02-20 - Marco Liu: Design review flagged two UX tradeoffs for structured output: strict schema enforcement vs. runtime leniency. Decision: default to lenient parse with optional strict mode toggle. See design notes: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xk_example_doc

2026-02-28 - Priya Shah (Engineering): Initial PR for Python SDK streaming helpers opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python-sdk/pull/482. Needs tests around partial-chunk framing. @Marco to prioritize.
2026-03-03 - Design feedback (DES-1190): Provided microcopy for streaming connection modal and error states. Minor revision requested for backoff wording.

2026-03-05 - Eng QA (ENG-2549): Staging run results: streaming latency under 95th pct SLA for hosted, but dedicated cluster showed tail spikes when concurrent warmups occurred. Mitigation: enable prefix KV caching and staggered warmup for canary traffic. Tracking ENG-2671 for kernel scheduling fix.

2026-03-08 - Docs update: Draft release notes at https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=87321. Please add missing SDK code samples to the 'Examples' section. Also created sample matrix: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sdk_sample_matrix

2026-03-09 - PM note: We should include a short migration snippet for users who previously relied on ad-hoc function schema parsing. Suggested snippet added to samples repo and referenced in release notes.
2026-03-10 - Security review kickoff: Security team requested threat model summary for function-calling's external tool integrations. Security review ticket opened: SEC-612.
2026-03-11 - Marketing alignment: GTM draft for customer newsletter and changelog uploaded to marketing drive. Need final quote from Eng lead for announcement.
2026-03-12 - Marco Liu: Verified sample CI all green across python/js/go; PR merge plan set for 2026-03-18. Preparing a pre-release partner preview on 2026-03-20.
risks: Breaking change surface area if structured-output typing is enforced by default
Streaming stability on some dedicated GPU pools under concurrent cold starts
Function-calling integrations may increase attack surface for downstream tool execution
Docs and sample gaps could cause increased support load in first week
mitigations: Ship structured output in lenient-parse mode and add opt-in strict validation flag; schedule strict-mode for vNext
Coordinate canary traffic shaping and enable staggered warmups for dedicated clusters; tracked in ENG-2671
Security review and threat modelling before GA; require allowlist for external tool endpoints
Lock sample matrix and run pre-merge CI across SDKs; prepare short 'common gotchas' doc for support
